repo.project_kind: Fast and extensible multi-platform HTTP/1-2-3 web server with automatic HTTPS

build_facts.note: Build feasibility is recorded from files and local toolchain presence only; no build was executed.

affected_packages.note: v2.11.4 is the frozen snapshot. Only the repository-scoped advisory and its rendered page carry this range; no mirror (OSV, NVD, CVE.org, global GHSA) has a record.

severity.derivation_method: CVSS 3.1 base metrics were chosen by the collector from the verified code path and the advisory text, then the base score was computed with the official 3.1 formula: AV:N (a remote client receives the upstream's response), AC:H (the upstream must be malicious or compromised and must answer the upgrade), PR:N, UI:R (the client must open the WebSocket upgrade), S:U, C:N (the leaked headers give no direct read of protected data), I:L (injected hop-by-hop headers can alter client/proxy connection state), A:N. The independent reviewer must recompute this vector and may replace or reject it; if the reviewer rejects it, the dossier must not be promoted.
severity.discrepancy_note: Severity is the only field in this dossier that is not a published value. Every published CVSS slot is null; the advisory provides only the label 'low'. The score is a documented analyst reading, flagged so that it can be audited and replaced.

metric_rationale.A: N - the repro shows no availability impact.
metric_rationale.AC: H - exploitation presupposes a malicious or compromised upstream that sets the headers; the client cannot inject them through Caddy.
metric_rationale.AV: N - the 101 response is delivered over the network to any client that opens the proxied WebSocket route.
metric_rationale.C: N - the repro shows header leakage only; no protected data is read.
metric_rationale.I: L - Alt-Svc/Set-Cookie/Proxy-Authenticate injection can change client connection state, but no integrity compromise was demonstrated beyond that.
metric_rationale.PR: N - no privileges on Caddy or the upstream are required of the victim.
metric_rationale.S: U - the impact stays within the client/proxy connection.
metric_rationale.UI: R - the victim has to establish the upgraded connection for the leaked response headers to reach it.

severity.numeric_level_rationale: The derived base score is 3.1, which is Low (0.1-3.9) and agrees with the advisory's published qualitative label 'low'. Because no published numeric metric exists, this score must not be cited as a vendor or CNA score.
severity.source: Analyst-derived CVSS 3.1 base metric; NOT vendor-published. The repository advisory publishes severity=low but leaves cvss.score/vector_string and both cvss_severities entries null, and no other database (global GHSA, OSV, NVD, CVE.org) has a record for CVE-2026-55458.
